Please watch: "Real Life Heroes 2019 Part 48 Faith In Humanity Restored" https://youtu.be/KCdJALjDp-A ‘Miracle baby’ found alive against all odds after 36 hours in frozen rubble of a 10-story building in #Magnitogorsk 🔔 Subscribe to Restore Your Faith in Humanity ▶︎ https://youtube.com/user/RealLifeHeroesTV?sub_confirmation=1 A New Year's Eve gas explosion ripped through a 10-story building. On 31st of December, laboring in temperatures around minus 20 degrees Celsius (minus 4 degrees Fahrenheit), Russian rescue workers were digging into a rubble from a collapsed apartment building when one heard the faintest sound.
Rescue worker Pyotr Gritsenko said on Russian television that baby's discovery came after one of the crew heard faint cries. It was the sound of life. "We stopped all the equipment. He began to cry louder," but the crew couldn't find him, he said. A search dog was brought in and they pulled a baby boy out of the rubble alive nearly 36 hours after the disaster that blew apart his home. The boy, an 11-month-old named Ivan Fokin, was in extremely serious condition, with fractures, a head injury and suffering from hypothermia. He was flown to Moscow in a desperate attempt to save his life. More than 30 people who lived in the building have are still missing. Although Ivan's prospects for survival appeared dire, His father called it "a #NewYearMiracle". Let’s pray for his recovery. #PrayForIvan

The terror attack in Stockholm, Sweden left five people (and about 14 injured) and one dog dead. These real life heroes ignored danger & saved lives of co-citizens: by alarming pedestrians about dangerous truck deliberately driven into crowds, helping those who are injured & launching a twitter-campaign to help people find a safe place in a city that for a day became overfull of fear and chaos.
This video was definitely the most difficult to make. Not because of the editing, research & finding video sources or figuring out a way to tell this story (through the eyes of Sweden's biggest hero Zlatan Ibrahimović)... But because of the fact that I was forced to relive that day again and again until this video was finally done. Remembering how I felt when I found out that one of my hometowns is attacked - while I'm being so close to the place where the terror attack took place.
I've made this video in order to share the stories of brave men and women who did their best to protect the citizens; who saved injured people by being in the right place at the right time; who offered their homes to strangers in need of a safe place.
You are my HEROES. Thank you!
